categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the macOS label and resolves an OS-specific runtime limitation in select() on macOS and BSD systems.
categories.rationale: Resolves a platform-specific runtime failure on macOS and BSD systems where select() rejects timeouts above 10^8 seconds. Although it addresses supported-platform compatibility, it affects only the -rpcclienttimeout=0 invocation rather than general node build or run capability.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies socket wait timeout logic in src/util/sock.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a regression from #34342 where running bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately on macOS with 'Could not connect to the server'. Capping the timeout at INT_MAX milliseconds prevents select() from failing with EINVAL and restores the documented no-timeout behavior.
